title: Propeller Powered Sled
content: Here's one of the more unusual vehicles stored in the old barns out behind theRhinebeck Aerodrome. Basically it's an aircraft engine and open propeller mounted on the back of a 1920s-era body, with sled runners instead of wheels.Old timers told me they would take this thing out on the Hudson River ice in the winter and zoom along at 60 miles per hour.-----Previously:Morgan Three-Wheeler at the Aerodrome
